description: This file defines the PartitionedQueueConsumerManager class, which manages partitioned queue consumers, including adding, removing, and deleting partitions and topics within a messaging queue system.

classes.name: PartitionedQueueConsumerManager
classes.description: Manages partitioned queue consumers, handling partition addition, removal, and topic deletion.

methods.name: processTask
methods.description: Processes different queue management tasks such as adding, removing, or deleting partitions.

methods.name: addPartitions
methods.description: Adds partitions with optional stop callback and start offset provider.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified partitions and their associated topics.
